# How many appointments do you lose to no-shows, and who and when?

> Free tool for salons, barbers, clinics, tutors and trainers: drop in your booking export and see your no-show and late-cancel rate, the revenue lost, which weekdays, hours and services get missed, your repeat no-show clients, and what a deposit or no-show fee might recover.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
